parts: 🚀 AI SKILLS & OPEN-SOURCE DISCOVERIES Date: 16 Nov 2026, 23:48 UTC Discovery period: 16 Nov 20:47 – 16 Nov 23:48 UTC New discoveries: 8 🧠 AI AGENT BUILDING 1. huggingface/pybot 🟠 P1 Highly useful · score 79/100 ★ 155 · 12 forks · 0 open issues · 5 contributors · updated today Developer: huggingface What it does: A chatbot written entirely in pure Python using rule-based patterns, regular expressions, and lookup tables generated by an agent swarm. Why it matters: It offers a fascinating look at how far pure programmatic logic and rules can go without any LLM weights. Practical application: Clone the repository and run it locally to study its modular rule structure or use it as a lightweight offline chatbot base. Compatibility: Hugging Face, Python Cost: Free and open source Licence: Apache-2.0 💼 Great inspiration for experimental personal AI agent designs. Also useful for: app development, hackathon projects 🔗 Repository: github.com/huggingface/pybot 2. anthropics/FlashProve 🔵 P2 Worth exploring · score 67/100 ★ 1,063 · 113 forks · 4 open issues · updated 17 days ago Developer: anthropics What it does: A research artifact providing zero-knowledge proofs of AI inference using Lean 4 and hardware commitments. Why it matters: It demonstrates cutting-edge cryptographic verification for AI inference, backed by formal proofs in Lean 4. Practical application: Explore the repository structure and Lean theorem proofs to understand state-of-the-art cryptographic verification of LLM outputs. Compatibility: Python Cost: Free and open source (needs: GPU) Licence: Apache-2.0 💼 Relevant for advanced research in personal AI agent security and trustworthiness. Also useful for: hackathon projects 🔗 Repository: github.com/anthropics/flashprove 🛠 AI SKILLS AND PROMPTS 3. Oldcircle/geo-sleuth 🟠 P1 Highly useful · score 84/100 ★ 7,134 · 887 forks · 28 open issues · 17 contributors · updated today What it does: An agent skill that uses OpenStreetMap, elevation data, satellite tiles, and street view to determine the exact geographic location where a photo was taken. Why it is useful: It transforms an AI agent into a capable OSINT tool that performs precise geolocation reasoning entirely via local scripts. Where it can be integrated: Agent skill directory or via the skills CLI (e.g., `npx skills add Oldcircle/geo-sleuth`) Installation: npx skills add Oldcircle/geo-sleuth Cost: Free and open source 💼 Fits seamlessly into your Claude Code, Codex, and agent-building projects. Also useful for: agent building, developer productivity 🔗 Original link: github.com/oldcircle/geo-sleuth (1/3)

4. mvanhorn/last30days-skill 🟠 P1 Highly useful · score 82/100 ★ 68,101 · 6,035 forks · 32 open issues · 172 contributors · updated today What it does: An AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary. Why it is useful: It gives AI agents native multi-platform search capabilities across walled gardens, prioritizing real human engagement and attention metrics. Where it can be integrated: Agent skills folder or Claude Code plugin marketplace Installation: npx skills add mvanhorn/last30days-skill -g Cost: Free and open source 💼 Directly supports your AI News Agent project by aggregating real-time community discussions. Also useful for: creator tools, agent building 🔗 Original link: github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill 5. alibaba/open-code-review 🟠 P1 Highly useful · score 82/100 ★ 52,913 · 4,294 forks · 335 open issues · 222 contributors · updated today What it does: A hybrid code review tool combining deterministic rulesets with an LLM agent to deliver line-level comments and security checks. Why it is useful: It brings Alibaba-tested reliability and multi-language vulnerability scanning (SQL injection, XSS, thread safety) directly into your review pipeline. Where it can be integrated: CLI tool or Git hooks in a software development project Installation: npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review Cost: Free and open source 💼 Integrates smoothly into your local coding agent development workflows. Also useful for: developer productivity, agent building 🔗 Original link: github.com/alibaba/open-code-review ⚡ AI AUTOMATION AND WORKFLOWS 6. fforster/gitlab-mcp 🟠 P1 Highly useful · score 81/100 ★ 86 · 147 forks · updated today What it does: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects AI assistants to GitLab repositories and issues. Workflow it improves: GitLab repository management and issue tracking Practical use: Configure it in your MCP client to allow your coding agent to read issues, check merge requests, and interact with GitLab repositories directly. Requirements: no paid API, subscription or GPU mentioned in its README 💼 Useful for extending your AI News Agent or other automation workflows to GitLab. 🔗 Original link: gitlab.com/fforster/gitlab-mcp 7. wgjsg/agilex-docs-mcp 🔵 P2 Worth exploring · score 69/100 ★ 1 · 0 open issues · updated 3 days ago What it does: An MCP server providing read-only documentation for AgileX Robotics products, including manuals, CAN protocols, and firmware notes. Workflow it improves: Robotics software development and hardware integration Practical use: Add the Streamable HTTP endpoint to your MCP client when building integrations for AgileX robots. Requirements: no paid API, subscription or GPU mentioned in its README 💼 Fits right into your Claude Code and Codex development environment for hardware projects. Also useful for: developer productivity, skills and instructions 🔗 Original link: github.com/wgjsg/agilex-docs-mcp (2/3)

💻 DEVELOPER PRODUCTIVITY 8. ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp 🔴 P0 Exceptional discovery · score 89/100 ★ 57,663 · 4,848 forks · 127 open issues · 169 contributors · updated today What it does: An MCP server and CLI tool that gives coding agents full control over a live Chrome browser via DevTools and Puppeteer. Workflow it improves: Front-end debugging and automated web verification Compatibility: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code, MCP, Node.js Cost: Free and open source 💼 Connects directly to your Claude Code and Gemini development workflows. Also useful for: agent building, automation 🔗 Original link: github.com/chromedevtools/chrome-devtools-mcp 🏆 BEST DISCOVERY mvanhorn/last30days-skill · open Why it ranked first: It directly matches your AI News Agent project by unlocking multi-platform social search and trend synthesis across Reddit, X, YouTube, and Polymarket. What problem it solves: AI models are typically locked inside walled gardens and cannot natively search real-time community discussions and prediction markets simultaneously.
